shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin has been trading flat around $77,000-$78,000, with the Fear & Greed Index reflecting a cautious investor sentiment at 31.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded nine consecutive days of inflows, indicating sustained institutional interest and accumulation.
SEC Chair Paul Atkins announced 'Project Crypto,' a new framework designed to enable on-chain trading of tokenized securities.
Ongoing geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East continue to dampen risk appetite across financial markets, including cryptocurrencies.
